preconditions.description: The dimensions n, m, and k are within the specified range.
The number of layers matches the given dimension n.

preconditions.expression: all(len(layer) == m for layer in layers)
all(all(len(row) == k for row in layer) for layer in layers)
preconditions.description: Each row in a layer has k characters.

preconditions.expression: all(all(char in '01' for char in row) for layer in layers for row in layer)
preconditions.description: Each character in the layers is either '0' or '1'.

postconditions.description: The number of critical CPUs is non-negative.
The number of critical CPUs does not exceed the total number of CPUs.
